Why REELR
could click on campus.
01

Close enough to meet

Discovery stays around a campus community, so matches feel more relevant to real plans.

02

Intent is visible

Casual, dating, friends, and open options reduce guesswork before anyone starts chatting.

Video before text

Short prompts show personality quickly. The first message has something specific to respond to.
